135: /// A (monotoically increasing) number that uniquely identifies a thread that's

139: /// the thread token identifies a thread of a given replica
140: ///
141: ///  - Dafny: linear datatype ThreadOwnedContext
142: pub struct ThreadToken<DT: Dispatch> {
143:     /// the replica id this thread uses
144:     pub  /* REVIEW: (crate) */
145:      rid: ReplicaToken,
146:     /// identifies the thread within the replica
147:     pub  /* REVIEW: (crate) */
148:      tid: ThreadId,
149:     /// the flat combiner client of the thread
150:     pub fc_client: Tracked<FlatCombiner::clients>,
151:     /// the permission to access the thread's operation batch
152:     pub batch_perm: Tracked<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
153: }

155: impl<DT: Dispatch> ThreadToken<DT> {
156:     pub open spec fn wf2(&self, num_replicas: nat) -> bool {
157:         &&& self.rid.wf(num_replicas)
158:         &&& self.fc_client@.value().is_Idle()
159:         &&& (self.tid as nat)
160:             < MAX_THREADS_PER_REPLICA
161:         // &&& self.fc_client@@.instance == fc_inst
162: 
163:         &&& self.batch_perm@.mem_contents().is_uninit()
164:         &&& self.fc_client@.key() == self.tid as nat
165:     }

167:     pub open spec fn wf(&self, replica: &Replica<DT>) -> bool {
168:         &&& self.wf2(replica.spec_id() + 1)  // +1 here because ids got < replicas
169: 
170:         &&& self.rid@ == replica.spec_id()
171:         &&& self.fc_client@.instance_id() == replica.flat_combiner_instance@.id()
172:         &&& self.batch_perm@@.pcell == replica.contexts[self.thread_id_spec() as int].batch.0.id()

242: ///
243: ///  - Dafny: linear datatype Context = Context(
244: ///  - Rust:  pub(crate) struct Context<T, R, M>
245: ///
246: /// Note, in contrast to the Rust version, we just have a single outstanding operation
247: #[repr(align(128))]
248: pub struct Context<DT: Dispatch> {
249:     /// Array that will hold all pending operations to be appended to the shared
250:     /// log as well as the results obtained on executing them against a replica.
251:     ///
252:     /// This is protected by the `atomic` field.
253:     ///
254:     ///  - Dafny: linear cell: CachePadded<Cell<OpResponse>>
255:     ///  - Rust:  pub(crate) batch: [CachePadded<PendingOperation<T, R, M>>; MAX_PENDING_OPS],
256:     pub/*REVIEW: (crate)*/ batch: CachePadded<PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
257: 
258:     /// The number of operations in this context, (just 0 or 1)
259:     ///
260:     ///  - Dafny: linear atomic: CachePadded<Atomic<uint64, ContextGhost>>,
261:     ///  - Rust:  N/A
262:     pub/*REVIEW: (crate)*/ atomic: CachePadded<AtomicU64<_, ContextGhost<DT>, _>>,
263: 
264:     /// ghost: identifier of the thread
265:     pub thread_id_g: Ghost<nat>,
266: 
267:     pub flat_combiner_instance: Tracked<FlatCombiner::Instance>,
268:     pub unbounded_log_instance: Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>,
269: }

271: pub open spec fn wf(&self, thread_idx: nat) -> bool {
272:     predicate {
273:         self.thread_id_g@ == thread_idx
274:     }
275:     invariant on atomic with (flat_combiner_instance, unbounded_log_instance, batch, thread_id_g) specifically (self.atomic.0) is (v: u64, g: ContextGhost<DT>) {
276:         &&& g.inv(v, thread_id_g@, batch.0, flat_combiner_instance@, unbounded_log_instance@)
277:     }

281: impl<DT: Dispatch> Context<DT> {
282:     pub fn new(
283:         thread_id: usize,
284:         slot: Tracked<FlatCombiner::slots>,
285:         flat_combiner_instance: Tracked<FlatCombiner::Instance>,
286:         unbounded_log_instance: Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>,
287:     ) -> (res: (Context<DT>, Tracked<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>))

302:         }
303:         // create the storage for storing the update operation

305:         let batch = CachePadded(batch);
306:         // create the atomic with the ghost context
307:         let tracked context_ghost = ContextGhost {
308:             batch_perms: None,
309:             slots: slot.get(),
310:             update: Option::None,
311:         };
312:         let atomic = CachePadded(
313:             AtomicU64::new(
314:                 Ghost((flat_combiner_instance, unbounded_log_instance, batch, Ghost(thread_id_g))),
315:                 0,
316:                 Tracked(context_ghost),
317:             ),
318:         );
319:         // Assemble the context, return with the permissions
320:         (
321:             Context {
322:                 batch,
323:                 atomic,
324:                 thread_id_g: Ghost(thread_id_g),
325:                 flat_combiner_instance,
326:                 unbounded_log_instance,
327:             },
328:             batch_perms,
329:         )
330:     }

332:     /// Enqueues an operation onto this context's batch of pending operations.
333:     ///
334:     /// This is invoked by the thread that want's to execute an operation
335:     ///
336:     /// Note, enqueue is a bit a misnomer. We just have one operation per thread
337:     pub fn enqueue_op(
338:         &self,
339:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
340:         context_ghost: Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>,
341:     ) -> (res: (bool, Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>))
342:         requires
343:             context_ghost@.enqueue_op_pre(
344:                 self.thread_id_g@,
345:                 op,
346:                 self.batch.0.id(),
347:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
348:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
349:             ),
350:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
351:         ensures
352:             res.1@.enqueue_op_post(context_ghost@),
353:             res.1@.cell_id == self.batch.0.id(),
354:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),

361:         } = context_ghost.get();
362:         let tracked mut batch_perms = batch_perms.tracked_unwrap();
363:         let tracked local_updates = local_updates.tracked_unwrap();
364:         // put the operation there, updates the permissions so we can store them in the GhostContext
365:         self.batch.0.put(Tracked(&mut batch_perms), PendingOperation::new(op));
366:         let tracked send_request_result;
367:         let res =
368:             atomic_with_ghost!(
369:             &self.atomic.0 => store(1);
370:             update prev->next;
371:             ghost g => {
372:                 let ghost tid = fc_clients.key();
373:                 let ghost rid = local_updates.key();
374: 
375:                 self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().pre_send_request(tid, &fc_clients, &g.slots);
376:                 send_request_result = self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().send_request(tid, rid, fc_clients, g.slots);

387:             batch_perms: None,
388:             cell_id,
389:             local_updates: None,

391:         };
392:         (true, Tracked(new_context_ghost))
393:     }

395:     /// Returns a single response if available. Otherwise, returns None.
396:     ///

401:     ) -> (res: (Option<DT::Response>, Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>))

412:     {

416:             local_updates: mut local_updates,
417:             fc_clients: mut fc_clients,

421:             atomic_with_ghost!(
422:             &self.atomic.0 => load();
423:             returning res;
424:             ghost g => {
425:                 if res == 0 {
426:                     batch_perms = g.batch_perms;
427:                     local_updates = g.update;

429:                     let tid = fc_clients.key();
430:                     let rid = fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0();

432:                     recv_response_result = self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().recv_response(tid, rid, fc_clients, g.slots);

513: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
514: // Ghost Context
515: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
516: struct_with_invariants!{
517: /// The ghost context for a thread carying permissions and tracking the state of the update operation
518: ///
519: ///  - Dafny:   glinear datatype ContextGhost = ContextGhost(
520: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
521:     /// Token to access the batch cell in Context
522:     ///
523:     ///  - Dafny: glinear contents: glOption<CellContents<OpResponse>>,
524:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
525: 
526:     /// The flat combiner slot.
527:     ///
528:     ///  - Dafny: glinear fc: FCSlot,
529:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
530: 
531:     /// tracks the update operation
532:     ///
533:     ///  - Dafny: glinear update: glOption<Update>
534:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
535: }
536: 
537: //  - Dafny: predicate inv(v: uint64, i: nat, cell: Cell<OpResponse>, fc_loc_s: nat)
538: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
539:     predicate {
540:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
541:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
542: 
543:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
544:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
545:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
546: 
547:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
548:             &&& self.update.is_none()
549:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
550:         })
551: 
552:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
553:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
554:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
555:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
556:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
557: 
558:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
559:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
560:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
561:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
562:         })
563: 
564:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
565:             &&& self.update.is_none()
566:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
567:         })
568: 
569:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
570:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
571:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
572:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
